No change to frozen data, reference tiers or scoring weights followed model exposure. The scorer gained an explicit supported_novel state after the dry pilot: supported new claims must not be mislabelled unsupported or inflate reference recall. Every run uses the same scorer version.
Joint matches are explicit: complementary selected claims can jointly recover a reference proposition. No lexical matching is used.
Human correction counts, preference scores and active review time are pending; agent-proposed edits are not measured human burden.

Raw runs used an independently chosen weighted variance estimator and a broader interaction Holm family. Primary proportions reproduce the reference. Exact p-values are not directly comparable: the raw public brief did not freeze the same complete variance specification. Raw data also contains likes/dislikes not included in the approved-analysis extract. This is a pilot confound, not proof of model calculation failure.
